description: Unit: Shared runner preserves timed pass/warn/skip results and HTTP data; unexpected Graph errors become safe failures with correlation metadata. Table-test overall fold precedence and skip handling.
Regression: Run existing shared/services/email/providers/__tests__/MicrosoftGraphAdapter.diagnostics.test.ts unchanged after extraction, including report and optional subscription behavior.
Unit: Construct Direct and CIPP report fixtures and verify stable step order/IDs, summary fields, client-only nesting, JSON-safe non-recursive support bundle, and empty clients in connection scope.

Unit: Table-test AADSTS65001/700016/7000222/50076/50079/70000/90002/50020, consent_required, invalid_client, invalid_grant, and network; specific codes override generic errors and partner/customer remedies differ.
Unit: Verify recommendation severity order/deduplication, distinct customer consent URLs, correct bound application client_id rather than Alga client id, and safe copy/open/navigate payloads.

Unit: Missing refresh token and failed refresh skip dependent token/discovery checks with blocked-by source; worker failure does not block Graph, and all auth failures still allow local history/queue checks.

Integration: Exercise auth/readiness routes/actions with unauthenticated, client-portal, missing read permission, missing INTEGRATIONS, missing ENTRA_SYNC, authorized read-only, and CE contexts; denied calls perform no integration/secret reads and preserve safe denial details.

DB integration: Against migrated schema, seed connection/profile/binding/mappings/settings/history/queue and run a successful report using test secret/Temporal/Graph adapters; assert actual query outputs and unchanged domain tables.

DB integration: Seed two isolated workspaces with overlapping lookup shapes; reject foreign client selections and cross-user/tenant continuation access; verify no foreign profile/mapping/run/queue data or secret reads escape.

DB integration: Run missing-connection/missing-settings/no-history paths against migrated schema and assert useful results with no defaults, preflight records, settings rows, discovery, or validation writes inserted.
Unit: Table-test missing binding, missing profile, archived profile, missing entra capability, absent/blank secret, fingerprint-only success, unknown expiry, under-30-day expiry and expired secret.

Unit: Verify connect/setup/diagnostics callback equality for environment/secret base URL precedence and trailing slashes; expected values stay informational with missing binding and never call Graph applications.

Unit: Table-test Temporal frontend/namespace failure, absent worker pollers, matching interval/next fire, mismatched enabled schedule, enabled missing schedule, and disabled absent schedule; assert no schedule mutation or workflow start.

Unit: Token tests cover missing refresh, refreshable missing/expired access, forced common refresh persistence, scope warnings, opaque claims, app mismatch, and tenant-token refresh rotation without overwriting partner access token.

Emulator integration: Run a green Direct connection end to end against msgraph emulator with paged discovery and mapped/unmapped tenants; verify layer order, me/probe correlation data, counts/samples and no customer token mint.

Emulator integration: Inject partner consent_missing 403 and verify actionable partner consent failure, request-id, dependent discovery skips, preserved local history, and no persisted connection verdict.
Emulator integration: Inject AADSTS7000222 on refresh and verify secret-rotation remedy, preserved OAuth/suberror metadata, skipped Graph layers, no forbidden writes and no raw secret in report.
Emulator integration: Return zero managed tenants and verify warning with Lighthouse/GDAP explanation, zero count, and missing-mapping warnings rather than a healthy pass.

Unit/integration: Verify production beta probe URL and self-tenant smoke /organization override, plus 400 endpoint-fault versus 401 token-rejected classification with request-id; endpoint overrides reach the emulator.

Emulator integration: Run selected clients where one succeeds and another mints AADSTS65001; verify tenant-specific consent URL/remedy, independent successful result, correct aggregate, and exactly one mint per ordinary client attempt.

Emulator integration: Return per-client /users 403 and verify GDAP directory-role remedy/request-id and missing-role category, while an independently accessible groups read and other clients still complete.

Unit/integration: Exercise entitlement group success with checkMemberGroups, deleted group 404, non-security group, no configured group, empty users and failed users read; verify independent group evidence and precise membership skip reasons.

Unit: Feed representative users through actual existing filter logic and assert total/included counts and disabled/missing-identity/service-account/custom-pattern exclusions; cover all-excluded and empty-directory warnings.
DB integration: Run opt-in yield with real stored custom filter settings and adapter user fixtures; verify expected counts, existing token reuse, and zero new contacts/queue/sync-run/settings rows.
Integration: CIPP candidate fixture returns 404 then successful alternative list; verify candidate order, selected endpoint, normalized count/sample, mapping warnings and no Direct secret dependency.
Unit/integration: Table-test missing CIPP credentials, DNS/TLS/timeout, HTTP error and 401/403; verify reachability versus auth attribution, API-key-specific remedy, skips and secret redaction.
Integration: CIPP empty list warns specifically about CIPP configuration; selected-client default reads stop at one page, while opt-in yield exhausts pages and shares exclusion semantics.

DB integration: Seed last-five runs with failed/partial/dry-run combinations, nested OAuth error, per-tenant failures and aged queue items; verify totals/durations, consecutive-real-sync warning, latest-real-run selection and oldest queue age.

Integration: Drive a 50-client continuation fixture through multiple requests, asserting bounded batches and at most three active clients, incremental completed results, one-client failure isolation and no process-local background dependency.

Integration: Exercise omitted versus empty selection, tampered/expired continuation, changed mapping/connection, rechecked permissions, interrupted run and retry; reject unsafe continuation before external calls and preserve completed UI results.

Integration: Exercise multi-page optional preview exceeding a request budget; return honest partial/continuation state, preserve counts without duplicate pages, and never expose credentials in job state or mark unfinished work green.

Security/unit: Seed sentinel access/refresh/client/API tokens and nested Axios/Graph/Temporal error payloads; verify server response plus copy/download contain only fingerprints, endpoint/action identifiers redact by default, includeIdentifiers never reveals secrets, and request IDs survive.

Component: Render Direct and CIPP fixture reports in standard dialog; assert overall/summary/ordered details/recommendations and client rows show names, not GUIDs, including unavailable-name fallback and optional expanded identifiers.

Component: Verify default all-mapped selection, off-by-default yield, explicit empty selection and >20 confirmation; exercise incremental progress, duplicate-start prevention, partial failure/retry and no more polling after close.

Component: Exercise copy/open/navigate recommendations and copy/download support bundle on secret-sentinel fixtures; verify consent URL action, shared export serialization, includeIdentifiers control and no secret leakage.
Component: Render current client diagnostics beside previous sync failures and verify identity-based cross-reference with timestamps, without labeling an old failure as a current one.

Component/build: Verify Connection and unhealthy Overview entry points, diagnostics localization keys, keyboard/status labels and theme-aware standard components; type/build-check EE and CE route exports.

Docs regression: Run server/src/test/unit/docs/entraIntegrationGuide.contract.test.ts and validate one consolidated AADSTS remedy table plus documented diagnostic scopes/read-only behavior/client outcomes.

Manual smoke: On the dev stack wired to msgraph emulator, run connection and selected-client diagnostics; capture green screenshot and two failure screenshots (partner consent or expired secret, and customer consent or GDAP role); inspect resulting safe bundles and unchanged connection state.

Documentation acceptance: Locate nm-store using alga-business-documentation, validate/build its new page, verify click paths and client-table explanations against actual smoke screenshots, and record page/evidence paths without claiming unperformed publication.
